key.name: filter
key.description: "all", "hidden" (only apps hidden from launchers) or "system" (only apps installed outside your home folder).

key.name: source
key.summary: Only list apps from this source

key.name: show-hidden
key.summary: List hidden apps in All apps and System

key.name: show-no-display
key.summary: Include apps not shown in menus

key.name: theme
key.description: "system" follows the desktop's dark mode setting.

key.name: accent
key.description: Six hex digits; "desktop" to follow the desktop's accent colour; or "palette" for the chosen palette's own accent.

key.name: palette
key.description: "generated" builds every colour from the accent; the others use a well-known colour scheme.

key.name: themed-icon
key.summary: Colour the app icon with the accent
key.description: Writes a copy of the app icon in the accent colour to your icon folder, so launchers show it.

key.name: window-controls
key.summary: Show minimize, maximize and close buttons

key.name: check-updates
key.summary: Look for updates when App Entries starts
key.description: Asks GitHub for the release list at most once every six hours. Nothing about you is sent.

key.name: update-notify
key.summary: Show a notification when there's a new version

key.name: update-test
key.description: Also offer releases marked as pre-releases on GitHub.

key.name: last-update-check
key.summary: When updates were last checked (Unix time)

key.name: recent-colors
key.description: Newest first, as #rrggbb. Shown in the icon picker.

key.name: latest-version
key.summary: The newest version found by the last check
